headline: Stable revenue growth, margin expansion key

highlights: In H1FY27, the company has restated its H1FY26 cash EBITDA calculations (IGAAP equivalent) to reflect the entire cash rental payments to landlords.
We retain our BUY rating with a revised TP of INR 384, post the new accounting calculation for IGAAP EBITDA valuing the company on 12x Sep’27E EV/IGAAP EBITDA.
Stable revenue traction; EBITDA margin improves QoQ Awfis reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of INR 4.4bn, which increased 20% YoY/3% QoQ, in-line with I-Sec estimates.
Under the revised cash EBITDA (IGAAP EBITDA) calculation, which the company introduced from FY27, Q2FY27 cash EBITDA grew 50% YoY to INR 0.5bn at an EBITDA margin of 10.8%.
valuation: While Q2FY27 cash EBITDA margin stood at 10.8%, the company is targeting exit margins of ~12% by Mar’27 and expects to clock 12%+ margins going forward.
Retain BUY with a revised TP of INR 384, based on 12x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Key risks: Office leasing slowdown and competition within flexspaces.
Key risks: Slowdown in overall office leasing across India and pricing competition among co-working flexible workspace operators.
